new_findings.summary: The VDS abbreviation table expands RTP as 'Real Time Protocol' and SOA as 'Server Oriented Architecture'. RFC 3550 identifies RTP as the real-time transport protocol / A Transport Protocol for Real-Time Applications, while the OASIS SOA Reference Model uses Service Oriented Architecture.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: none on XML/XSD; protocol and architecture terminology must follow the external standards rather than these erroneous expansions
